honesty.scripted: Every agent in the Omega Hive is SCRIPTED: each line it says is quoted verbatim from the registry path printed beside it. Nothing is generated, at build time or at view time.
honesty.no_model: No AI model runs behind any agent, and no network is reached. The council picks lines by counting shared words between a question and the quoted lines - a fixed rule that gives the same answer every time - and says so when nothing matches.
honesty.voice: Voice is the device's own speech synthesis (the browser's speechSynthesis, on-device voices only). It speaks only when you press a speak button, never on its own, and a mute switch silences it. No audio is recorded or sent anywhere.
honesty.personality: Personalities and voice settings are AUTHORED by hand for this roster; they change how a quoted line is delivered, never what it says.
honesty.not_a_person: No agent represents a real worker, teacher, ranger, pilot, union officer or public figure; names are the source registries’ own AUTHORED names.
honesty.play: Talking to an agent is play: it certifies nothing, unlocks nothing and enters no completion record. Lessons stay unverified general practice.

personality_provenance: AUTHORED - every trait, speaking style and voice setting in this file is written by hand for the Omega Hive. A personality is a description of how a scripted figure's quoted lines are delivered; it adds no line, no fact and no ability. No figure here represents a real person.
voice_rule: pitch and rate are the AUTHORED base for each figure; a guide in the NPC roster gets a DERIVED offset of sha256('<agent id>:voice')[:8] mod 9 minus 4, times 0.01, on each, so two guides of one role do not sound identical. Both are clamped to the bounds below. Volume is fixed. The text is spoken in English because every line is quoted as its registry writes it.

k12.rule: In classroom / K-12 mode the roster shows only the play-safe figures listed here, every line containing a word on the hold list is withheld (not reworded), and the voice starts muted until the class turns it on.

lines.text: Four words are used on every label and they mean exactly what they say. RECORDED is a fact taken from a cited source and checked against it. DERIVED is computed from a recorded fact. AUTHORED is typed from general public knowledge, not cross-checked against any file this build can verify - a materially weaker claim than RECORDED, and labelled as one. SCHEMATIC is drawn to teach and is not a survey of anywhere. The buildings you are standing in are SCHEMATIC.
